Ruth.title: Ruth
Ruth.question: How can loyal kindness create belonging after loss?

chapters.title: Leaving Moab
chapters.game: Pack lightly and choose whether to accompany Naomi.

chapters.title: Your People
chapters.game: Follow the road to Bethlehem together.

chapters.title: Gleaning
chapters.game: Collect only grain left for gleaners.

chapters.title: Boaz Notices
chapters.game: Deliver water and protection instructions to the workers.

chapters.title: At the Threshing Floor
chapters.game: Follow Naomi’s plan with restraint and clarity.

chapters.title: At the Gate
chapters.game: Arrange witnesses and present the redemption choice.

chapters.title: Redeemed
chapters.game: Transfer the sandal and join the households.

chapters.title: Obed
chapters.game: Build the family line toward David.
